summary: Prospect Peak lookout, Lassen Volcanic NP, Shasta County: built c.1912, cabin flown off by helicopter in 1981; whereabouts unknown.

facts.status_note: The cabin was flown off the peak by helicopter in 1981 and taken to Manzanita Lake; the register says its current status and whereabouts are unknown.
facts.agency: National Park Service, Lassen Volcanic National Park

events.note: Register: constructed in 1912 as a California Region 5 Plan 4A. The 1981 article repeats the 1912 date from park research.
Added to the National Register of Historic Places on March 30, 1978 (Wikipedia).
Cabin flown from the peak by helicopter to Manzanita Lake on July 21, 1981 (per the 1981 article), for a restoration the register says did not take place.
Registered April 15, 2020, nominated by Brad Eells.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wikipedia places the lookout on Prospect Peak and calls it otherwise intact, citing a 1977 nomination form. The register and the dated 1981 article say the cabin was flown off the peak in July 1981. The story follows the register and the 1981 article, which are more specific.

notes_for_editor: The brief's built 1912 and removed 1981 both check out against the register and the 1981 article. Open conflicts: (1) Wikipedia says the lookout is on the peak and otherwise intact, citing a 1977 NRHP nomination form by Gordon Chappell. The NPS nomination URL we tried (npgallery 78000295_text) returned a PNG image, not text, so the form itself was not read. (2) Mule route start: Blue Lake (register) vs Butte Lake (1981 article); both are quoted in the story. (3) The register's transfer to the San Bernardino NF is dated only to 'the early 2000's', so no event with a year is recorded for it. (4) The register says the Forest dismantled the Cajon Mountain tower. A search snippet from SummitPost describes a tower on Cajon summit 'missing its cabin and platform'. That page was not read, so it is not used; check it before relying on either account. Staffing and notable fires: none in the sources read, so none recorded. Access: the register gives no visiting information, so no access key. Do not confuse with West Prospect Peak, a separate lookout in Lassen National Forest; a search snippet says it is still in service, which is unverified and not used. No photos added.
